name: VBlankVector
comment: jp to VBlankHandler

name: Entry
comment: nop; jp Start

name: Start
comment: sets SP=$dfff; clears WRAM and HRAM; inits LCD and palettes; enters mode 0

name: GameModeDispatch
comment: rst $00 jump table indexed by A: 8 game modes (see REVERSE.md)

name: VBlankHandler
comment: runs OAM DMA; queued VRAM copies; scroll; bank 1 per-frame update $4157; frame counters

name: WaitSerialByte
comment: enables serial interrupt only and waits for hSerialByte

name: WaitFrameAndSyncOam
comment: waits one frame; requests OAM DMA

name: WaitVBlankFlag
comment: spins (bumping hRngCounter) until the VBlank handler sets hVBlankFlag

name: DelayFrames
comment: waits A frames

name: PlaySound
comment: stores A in wSoundArg and queues it with the bank 1 routine $485b

name: FadeOut
comment: steps BGP/OBP0/OBP1 e4-94-50-40-00

name: ReadJoypad
comment: hJoyHeld = buttons+dpad; hJoyNew = newly pressed

name: CopyOamDmaRoutine
comment: copies 10 bytes to $ff80

name: OamDmaRoutine
comment: source of the HRAM routine: DMA from $c000 then waits 40 cycles

name: PixelToTilemapAddr
comment: hSpriteY/X pixel to BG map address $9800+

name: RstJumpTable
comment: target of rst $00: pop hl; index word table after the rst

name: LcdOff
comment: waits for LY=$91 then clears LCDC bit 7

name: ClearMemory
comment: zero fill HL for BC bytes

name: FillBackwardsFF
comment: fills $400 bytes with $ff going down from HL

name: CopyMemory
comment: copy BC bytes from HL to DE

name: Clear32Bytes
comment: zero fill HL for 32 bytes

name: SetObjPtr
comment: hObjPtr = HL

name: QueueVramCopyRows
comment: queue run-length VRAM copy for the next VBlank

name: QueueVramCopyList
comment: queue a list of VRAM copy jobs for the next VBlank

name: VramCopyRows
comment: run-length copy of rows to VRAM (from VBlank)

name: VramCopyList
comment: runs a list of VramCopyRows jobs (from VBlank)

name: WaitVramCopyDone
comment: waits until the VBlank task bit 2 is cleared

name: ClearOamShadowY
comment: clears Y of every OAM shadow entry

name: ClearOamShadow
comment: zero fills the 160 byte OAM shadow at $c000

name: RequestOamDma
comment: sets the OAM DMA bit in hVBlankTasks

name: LoadGfxBank2
comment: selects bank 2; copies $4000 (0x700 bytes) to VRAM $8000; then table-driven tiles to $8700

name: LoadTilesBank3A
comment: bank 3 $4000 0x1000 bytes to $8000 via LoadTilesBank3

name: LoadTilesBank3B
comment: bank 3 $5000 0x1000 bytes to $8000

name: LoadTilesBank3D
comment: bank 3 $6e10 0x1000 bytes to $8000

name: LoadTilesBank3C
comment: bank 3 $6000 0xe10 bytes to $8000

name: LoadTilesBank3
comment: copy BC bytes from bank 3 HL to VRAM $8000

name: SerialStartTransfer
comment: link port: clears internal clock bit; sets transfer start

name: SerialHandler
comment: serial interrupt: stores received byte state in hSerialByte flags

name: TimerValueTable
comment: 16-bit values indexed by $c522 loaded into $c44a/$c44b

name: Mode0_Title
comment: title screen: 1 PLAYER / 2 PLAYER; link-cable detection via the serial port

name: Mode1_Play
comment: gameplay in a room (paint the floor); loads tiles of bank 2

name: Mode2_BonusSelect
comment: SELECT JUST ONE! choose A/B/C

name: Mode3_RoundIntro
comment: ROUND nn / room name / lives / READY !!

name: Mode4_GameOver
comment: GAME OVER screen

name: Mode5_Continue
comment: CONTINUE? countdown with YES/NO

name: Mode6_Ending
comment: castle scene after the last round

name: Mode7_LinkLose
comment: SORRY YOU LOSE / TRY AGAIN (2 player loser)

name: SoundUpdate
comment: per-frame sound engine called from VBlankHandler

name: PlaySound_Bank1
comment: appends wSoundArg to the sound command queue

name: SoundDequeue
comment: pops the next command from the queue into wSoundCmd

name: SoundStartCommand
comment: commands >= $80 index word tables at $40f4 and $411a

name: SoundUpdateChannel
comment: one of 8 channel records of $20 bytes at wSoundChannels

name: DrawObject
comment: builds OAM sprites for the object record at hObjPtr from its animation data

name: LookupByte
comment: A = byte at HL + C (table lookup)

name: PlayFrame
comment: one frame of play mode: input; movement; collisions; drawing the player

name: PlayerAction
comment: handles the A button (paint action)

name: IsOnTileGrid
comment: B = X and C = Y: Z when both are multiples of 16

name: LoadPlayerXY
comment: B = wPlayerX and C = wPlayerY

name: ClampPlayerPosition
comment: keeps the player inside X $20-$f0 and Y $28-$f8

name: HoldDirectionUntilAligned
comment: keeps hJoyHeld direction until the player reaches the next tile

name: PlayerSetDirection
comment: dpad to wPlayerDir and the animation index

name: SelectPlayerAnimation
comment: picks the animation table by direction

name: RoundCleared
comment: runs when every path cell is painted ($c520 reached 0): restores palettes; plays sound $8a; clear animation

name: PlayerDeath
comment: waits $27 frames; plays sound $8b; runs the death animation (wPlayerDir bit 5)

name: SpriteTiles
comment: 2bpp sprite tiles (characters and enemies): first $700 bytes are copied to VRAM $8000

name: SpriteTilesPart2
comment: more sprite tiles; $900 bytes at an offset chosen from wRoomIndex are copied to $8700

name: Bank2Padding
comment: $ff padding to the end of the bank

name: TilesTitle
comment: title logo; font; copyright text (loaded by LoadTilesBank3A)

name: TilesIcons
comment: UI icons; round/status tiles (LoadTilesBank3B)

name: TilesEnding
comment: castle and trees: ending scene tiles (LoadTilesBank3C)

name: TilesFont2
comment: second font and misc tiles (LoadTilesBank3D)

name: Bank3Padding
comment: $ff padding to the end of the bank

name: ObjectShapeTable
comment: word pointers indexed by animation frame; each entry points at {count; dy; dx; tile; attr} sprite parts used by DrawObject

name: RoomTypeTable
comment: per room-type data indexed by wRoomType

name: SoundSongTable
comment: word offsets of song data (follows the frequency table at $4000)

name: SoundCommandDataTable
comment: per command word pointers used by SoundStartCommand

name: PlayerAnimPtrs
comment: player animation pointers (down/up/side) chosen by SelectPlayerAnimation

name: PlayerAnimPtrsFlipped
comment: pointers for the side animation drawn flipped

name: DirectionToAnimIndex
comment: dpad direction nibble to animation index

name: LookupWord
comment: HL = word at HL + A*2 (also copied to DE and BC)

name: MultiplyByDE
comment: signed multiply of A by DE (shift and add)

name: SerialSendByte
comment: sends C over the link port with the internal clock and waits for the reply

name: ByteToBCD
comment: converts a byte in A (and C flag) to decimal digits using daa

name: SelectObject2
comment: hObjPtr = hObject2

name: SetObjectAnimation
comment: stores DE as the animation pointer (record +1/+2) of hObject2

name: LookupMapTile
comment: A = wRoomMap tile at pixel Y with column E

name: UnpackRoomMap
comment: HL = packed map (2 bits per cell; 4 cells per byte) unpacked to the 256 byte wRoomMap

name: DrawMetatileMap
comment: draws a map of 2x2 tile metatiles: HL VRAM dest; BC metatile table; DE cell map; mask in $c7c0

name: RunVramCopyList
comment: BC = list of VRAM copy jobs run immediately

name: TableIndexFromRound
comment: A = (A-1)&15 or 16 for 32; then LookupWord

name: TableIndexFromRoundDec
comment: dec a then falls into TableIndexFromRound

name: RoomMetatileTable
comment: 17 pointers to metatile definitions per room theme

name: RoomSpriteSetTable
comment: 17 pointers into bank 2 to the sprite tile set copied to $8700 (0x900 bytes)

name: RoomMapTable
comment: 17 pointers to packed 64 byte room maps (index (round-1)&15; 16 = bonus)

name: RoomVramJobTable
comment: 17 pointers to VRAM copy job lists

name: TitleLoop
comment: title screen loop: serial check; joypad; button codes; Start sends the round over the link port

name: Mode2_Init
comment: bonus select setup after LcdOff

name: DrawDecimalDigits
comment: draws a byte as decimal digits using ByteToBCD

name: DrawTwoDigitNumber
comment: B = value drawn as two BCD digits at HL

name: TickObjectTimer
comment: increments $ffd0; Z flag from bit 7 of $ffd1

name: SoundWriteChannel1
comment: writes pulse channel 1 registers (NR11 NR12 NR13/NR14) from the channel record

name: SoundWriteChannel2
comment: writes pulse channel 2 registers (NR21 NR22 NR23/NR24)

name: SoundWriteChannel3
comment: writes wave channel 3 registers (NR32 NR33/NR34)

name: SoundWriteChannel4
comment: writes noise channel 4 registers (NR42 NR43 NR44)

name: SoundReadNextNote
comment: reads the next note byte from the channel's song pointer (+3/+4); bytes >= $e0 are commands

name: SoundApplyPitchSlide
comment: copies the pitch word at +$e into +$12 (frequency) for the channel writers

name: SetAnimationVariant
comment: DE = BC when bit 3 of $ffd0 is set; then SetObjectAnimation

name: UpdateAllEnemies
comment: starts the enemy loop with $c53f incremented and $c53e = 15

name: UpdateEnemyLoop
comment: for each slot index: load the slot into HRAM; run UpdateEnemy; store it back

name: UpdateEnemy
comment: one enemy step on the record held in hObject2

name: SelectEnemySlot
comment: HL = slot address from the word table at HL (A = index); stored in $ffd7/$ffd8

name: StoreEnemySlot
comment: copies the 32 byte HRAM object hObject2 back to its slot ($ffd7/$ffd8)

name: LoadEnemySlot
comment: copies a slot ($ffd7/$ffd8) into the HRAM object hObject2

name: ClearEnemySlot
comment: zero fills hObject2

name: EnemySlotTable
comment: 16 word addresses of the enemy slots: $c542 + $20 * i
